A woman in her 20s standing on a vivid blue outdoor floor, reaching her right palm out largely toward a camera overhead in the center of the screen. The main elements are her short brown hair, a white mini camisole dress with small pale blue flowers, and white high-top sneakers.

Character/Expression: 
A small round oval face, slightly large brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, a small nose, and pale rose-colored lips. Facing straight up with a calm expression looking up at the camera. Wet dark brown bob reaching the chin, thin clumped bangs, and wet strands along the cheeks. Silver thin hoop earrings and a small flower-shaped pendant.

A white camisole mini dress with scattered fine pale blue flower patterns. Clearly define the thin shoulder straps, the small knot in the center of the chest, the upper body following the body line, and the short frills at the hem. White high-top sneakers without socks. Standing with legs slightly apart, the left arm lowered to the side. The right arm extended overhead, directing the palm with widely spread fingers toward the lens. A thin silver ring on the middle finger of the right hand.

The background is filled only with a vivid blue outdoor floor with little unevenness, casting a dark shadow of the character toward the bottom left. Strong direct summer sunlight from the upper right brightens the water droplets in the hair, the forehead and cheeks, the palm, and the shoulders. 2:3 aspect ratio. An extreme high-angle wide-angle camera capturing the entire body vertically from almost directly above. The face is placed large in the upper center of the screen, and the right palm and fingers are exaggerated to be larger than the face due to perspective. Captures from the top of the head to both shoes, with the fingertips of the right hand near the top edge, and parts of the left and right arms cut off at the edges of the screen. Focus is on the face and palm, with a relatively deep depth of field reaching the floor.

Texture/Style: 
A photorealistic live-action photo taken outdoors at midday. Precisely depicts natural skin texture, fine water droplets, reflections of individual wet hair strands, small flower patterns and seams on thin fabric, and the used look of sneakers. Maintains the close perspective characteristic of wide-angle lenses, with a bright and refreshing summer tone.

title: Street Art Three-View Character Sheet
description: A comprehensive system-style prompt for creating a 3-view character design sheet with a street art aesthetic, focusing on consistent outfit application from a reference photo.
promptText:
# CUSTOM_STREET_ART_THREE_VIEW_SHEET

## [Purpose]
Using the single full-body image of a person attached to this instruction as the sole character reference, create one high-quality square three-view design sheet for sharing, featuring a fixed street art style setup outfit. The emphasis is on it functioning as a professional fashion design piece that works as a three-view character verification sheet.

## [Input]
Style: {argument name="style" default="Photorealistic"}
Gender is naturally inherited from the attached person image.

## [Absolute Constraints]
Aspect ratio is 1:1 square. Background is a light neutral gray close to white. The sheet density, page design, layout, and outfit design are fixed; only the person and their rendering style are variable. The switch between [Photorealistic / Anime] applies only to the three character depictions, not the canvas, background, panel structure, titles, or UI elements.

## [Character Reference]
Use the attached full-body image as the sole reference to ensure FRONT/SIDE/BACK are the same person. Maintain facial features, eyes, nose, mouth, hair style, hair color, age, skin tone, and body proportions. Do not redesign, beautify excessively, or alter the body type.

## [Rendering]
Photorealistic: High-quality fashion photography. Natural skin/hair, fabric thickness, drape, seams, and shadows.
Anime: High-quality anime expression maintaining the reference person's proportions and features. Clear patterns and silhouettes.

## [Fixed Outfit]
A unisex street art coordinated set using {argument name="primary color" default="white"} as the main color with bold abstract art in {argument name="accent colors" default="black, vivid red, and limited orange"}. Outer jacket, inner hoodie, and cargo pants share the same design language.

### Outer Jacket
White base oversized zip-up. Features black ribbing, asymmetrical rough black brush strokes, ink splashes, sharp red paint, and orange drips.

### Inner Hoodie
White base hooded sweatshirt. Must include matching black, red, and orange brush and drip patterns visible from the jacket opening and on the hood.

### Cargo Pants / Shoes
White-based wide cargo pants with asymmetrical abstract paint. Shoes are black and white platform volume sneakers.

## [Layout]
Divide the square into a large FRONT area on the left (approx. 60%) and two stacked panels on the right for 02 SIDE and 03 BACK (approx. 40%). Use thin black borders and aligned margins.

## [Graphics]
Fixed 2-line title in the top left: **STREET-ART COORDINATED SET**. Fixed view labels: 01 FRONT, 02 SIDE, 03 BACK.
